description: CAM6 physics boundary traces from an instrumented FSCAMARM97 (SCAM) run on the ne3np4 grid (PLAN.md 10.4 M2), default-gated by dump_cam=.false. and enabled in this run only: (a) D boundaries - instantaneous tendencies of every physics_update call in tphysbc/tphysac (physpkg.F90; 22 unique sites, 26 site-calls/step: 20 single sites plus clubb and microp repeated cld_macmic_num_steps=3 times in the macro-micro co-substep loop; macrop/microp_sc/carma_emis/carma_wetdep/nudging are gated off in this configuration - macrop_scheme='CLUBB_SGS', use_subcol_microp=.false., no CARMA, Nudge_Model=false; the SCM relaxation is dynamics-side in apply_iop_forcing.F90): the column state immediately before the update (T,u,v,s,pmid,pdel,ps,phis,zm,q_Q) plus the ptend to be applied (ptend_s/u/v, ptend_q_Q; per-constituent q_before/ptend_q in cam_phys_tend_q.csv) with the site context (dt, macmic substep, scale=1/cld_macmic_num_steps, top/bot levels, active flags, lat/lon); (b) cam_in/cam_out surface exchange per step (bc_in at tphysbc entry; bc_out after cam_export; ac_out at tphysac exit; cam_in%cflx per constituent in cam_surface_cflx.csv); (c) the wv_saturation qsat law (T,pmid -> es,qs,gam; Goff-Gratch mixed-phase table) at entry to tphysbc and tphysac; (d) accumulated tend%dtdt/dudt/dvdt at the end of tphysbc and tphysac; (e) the vertical-diffusion (vdiff) solver context per (step, level): solve-grid pressures (mid/ifc from Coords1D(state%pint)), interface rhoi/tint/dpidz_sq, eddy diffusivities kvh/kvm/kvq and countergradients cgh/cgs (zero in this window: stable column), wind damping tau_damp_rate, KE dissipation dtk, post-solve provisional u1/v1/s1, final ptend_s/u/v, pdel/pdeldry, Beljaars dragblj, residual stress tauresx/tauresy, ksrftms, clubbtop, surface taux/tauy/shflux, dse_top (cam_vdiff_prof.csv), plus per (step, level, constituent) q0/q1/ptend_q/cflx/do_diffusion (cam_vdiff_q.csv).

dump_files.cam_phys_tend.csv: step,ymd,tod,site,proc_name,active,lu,lv,ls,nlq,top_level,bot_level,macmic_it,macmic_num,dt,scale,lev,lat,lon,T,u,v,s,pmid,pdel,ps,phis,zm,q_Q,ptend_s,ptend_u,ptend_v,ptend_q_Q - one row per (step, physics_update call site, level); state columns are the column state immediately before the update (physpkg.F90 tphysbc/tphysac calls to physics_update, physics_types.F90:207); site is the call-site label (energy_fixer..nudging, see CAM_LANE.md table); proc_name is ptend%name ('none' when empty); active=1 if any ptend field set; lu/lv/ls = ptend%lu/lv/ls; nlq = count(ptend%lq); top_level/bot_level = ptend%top_level/bot_level; macmic_it/macmic_num = macro-micro co-substep index and cld_macmic_num_steps (0/1 outside the loop; macrop/clubb/microp_sc/microp repeat macmic_num times per step); dt = physics timestep [s]; scale = ptend scaling (1/cld_macmic_num_steps inside the macmic loop); T [K] u [m/s] v [m/s] s [J/kg] pmid [Pa] pdel [Pa] ps [Pa] phis [m2/s2] zm [m] q_Q [kg/kg] = state before update; ptend_s [J/kg/s] ptend_u/v [m/s2] ptend_q_Q [kg/kg/s] = tendencies to be applied (0 outside [top_level,bot_level] or when the flag is not set); lat/lon [deg]
dump_files.cam_phys_tend_q.csv: step,ymd,tod,site,lev,cnst_idx,cnst_name,q_before,ptend_q - one row per (step, site, level, constituent) for every constituent in ptend%lq (physics_types.F90:145); q_before [kg/kg] = state%q immediately before the update; ptend_q [kg/kg/s] = tendency; joins to cam_phys_tend.csv on (step,site,lev)
dump_files.cam_surface_exchange.csv: step,ymd,tod,phase,asdir,asdif,aldir,aldif,lwup,lhf,shf,wsx,wsy,tref,qref,u10,ts,sst,snowhland,snowhice,landfrac,icefrac,ocnfrac,cflx_Q,tbot,zbot,ubot,vbot,qbot_Q,pbot,rho,netsw,flwds,precsc,precsl,precc,precl,soll,sols,solld,solsd,thbot,psl,co2prog,co2diag,ozone - phase=bc_in = cam_in at entry to tphysbc (physpkg.F90:2325; surface albedos asdir/asdif/aldir/aldif, lwup [W/m2], lhf/shf [W/m2], wsx/wsy [N/m2], tref [K]/qref [kg/kg], u10 [m/s], ts/sst [K], snowhland/snowhice [m], landfrac/icefrac/ocnfrac, cflx_Q [kg/m2/s]; camsrfexch.F90:86); phase=bc_out = cam_out after cam_export (physpkg.F90:3119), phase=ac_out = cam_out at end of tphysac (physpkg.F90:2095; tbot [K] zbot [m] ubot/vbot [m/s] qbot_Q [kg/kg] pbot [Pa] rho [kg/m3], netsw [W/m2], flwds [W/m2], precsc/precsl/precc/precl [m/s] snow-conv/snow-large-scale/conv/large-scale precip, soll/sols/solld/solsd [W/m2], thbot [K] psl [Pa] co2prog/co2diag [mol/mol] ozone [mol/mol]; camsrfexch.F90:37); cam_in fields are 0 for bc_out/ac_out and cam_out fields are 0 for bc_in
dump_files.cam_surface_cflx.csv: step,ymd,tod,phase,cnst_idx,cnst_name,cflx - cam_in%cflx surface constituent fluxes [kg/m2/s] per constituent (camsrfexch.F90:113), phase=bc_in only
dump_files.cam_qsat.csv: step,ymd,tod,phase,lev,T,pmid,es,qs,gam - wv_saturation qsat law at entry to tphysbc (phase=bc, physpkg.F90:2326) and tphysac (phase=ac, physpkg.F90:1491): T [K] = state%t, pmid [Pa] = state%pmid; es [Pa] = saturation vapor pressure (estblf table lookup on the Goff-Gratch mixed-phase table, wv_saturation.F90:378), qs [kg/kg] = saturation specific humidity (svp_to_qsat = epsilo*es/(p-omeps*es), wv_sat_methods.F90:185), gam = (hltalt/cpair)*(dqsdt) with the pcf transition polynomial (wv_saturation.F90:521-600); computed by qsat_2D (wv_saturation.F90:851)
dump_files.cam_tend_total.csv: step,ymd,tod,phase,lev,dtdt,dudt,dvdt - accumulated physics tendencies: phase=bc = end of tphysbc (before coupling), phase=ac = end of tphysac (full step); dtdt [K/s] = tend%dtdt (accumulated ptend%s/cpairv, physics_types.F90:417-419), dudt/dvdt [m/s2] = tend%dudt/dvdt (physics_types.F90:289-300); tend is zeroed at the top of tphysbc (physpkg.F90:2326)
dump_files.cam_vdiff_prof.csv: step,ymd,tod,lev,mid,ifc_lo,ifc_hi,rhoi_lo,rhoi_hi,tint_lo,tint_hi,dpidz_lo,dpidz_hi,kvh_lo,kvh_hi,kvm_lo,kvm_hi,kvq_lo,kvq_hi,cgh_lo,cgh_hi,cgs_lo,cgs_hi,tau_damp_rate,dtk,u1,v1,s1,ptend_s,ptend_u,ptend_v,pdel,pdeldry,dragblj,tauresx,tauresy,ksrftms,clubbtop,taux,tauy,shflux,dse_top - one row per (step, level) at the single vdiff site (vertical_diffusion.F90 vertical_diffusion_tend, physpkg.F90:1715; called once per step); mid [Pa] = solve-grid layer midpoint (Coords1D(state%pint): mid=0.5(ifc(k)+ifc(k+1)), coords_1d.F90:75-86), ifc_lo/ifc_hi [Pa] = interface pressures below/above the layer; rhoi [kg/m3] tint [K] dpidz_sq [kg2/m4/s4] kvh/kvm/kvq [m2/s] cgh [J/kg/m] cgs [s/m2] at the lo and hi interfaces (k, k+1): density/temperature interpolation (vertical_diffusion_interpolate_to_interfaces_run, diffusion_solver.F90:97), (dp/dz)^2, eddy diffusivities and countergradients (kvf of hb_diff_free_atm_exchange_coefficients_run, zero below clubbtop, holtslag_boville_diff.F90:640-671; all zero in this window because the column is stably stratified - calc_free_atm_eddy_flux_coefficient nonzero only for Ri<0, atmos_phys_pbl_utils.F90:151-173); tau_damp_rate [1/s] = wind damping (vertical_diffusion_wind_damping_rate_run + beljaars_add_wind_damping_rate_run); dtk [J/kg] = KE dissipation added to dry static energy; u1/v1 [m/s] s1 [J/kg] = post-solve provisional states (u_tmp/v_tmp/s_tmp after all solver stages incl. the explicit bottom-layer flux and dropmixnuc); ptend_s [J/kg/s] ptend_u/v [m/s2] = final tendencies (dry constituents converted by pdel/pdeldry for tracers; s/u/v wet); pdel/pdeldry [Pa] = wet/dry layer thicknesses; dragblj [1/s] = Beljaars SGO form-drag profile; per-step columns (repeated on every row): tauresx/tauresy [N/m2] residual surface stress memory (do_iss=.true., taures accumulates each step), ksrftms [kg/s/m2] TMS surface drag, clubbtop [1] = HB zeroing top level, taux/tauy [N/m2] shflux [W/m2] = surface fluxes into the solver (0 with CLUBB_SGS; hb_free_atm_diff_prepare_vertical_diffusion_inputs_run, holtslag_boville_diff_interstitials.F90:145-147), dse_top [J/kg] = top dry-static-energy boundary condition (0 without molecular diffusion); dump written by cam_dump_vdiff_prof (cam_dump_mod.F90), called after vertical_diffusion_tendencies_run (vertical_diffusion.F90:1848)
dump_files.cam_vdiff_q.csv: step,ymd,tod,lev,cnst_idx,cnst_name,q0,q1,ptend_q,cflx,do_diffusion - one row per (step, level, constituent) at the vdiff site; q0 [kg/kg] = state%q before the tracer solve; q1 [kg/kg] = post-solve q_tmp (all solver stages incl. the dropmixnuc explicit bottom-layer flux, vertical_diffusion.F90:1796-1803); ptend_q [kg/kg/s] = final tendency (dry constituents converted by pdel/pdeldry, diffusion_solver.F90:1056-1061); cflx [kg/m2/s] = surface constituent flux into the solver (coupler cflx minus water vapor, hb_free_atm_diff_prepare_vertical_diffusion_inputs_run); do_diffusion = T/F whether the constituent is diffused in vertical_diffusion_diffuse_tracers_run (all non-dropmixnuc constituents, vertical_diffusion.F90:436-452)
